components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button - flat design with hover lift
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #43B3E0; color: #fff; padding: 1em 2.35em; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease-in-out, transform 0.1s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #43bff0; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Prayer Time Card
components.css: .ds-prayer-card { background: #fff; padding: 2em; box-shadow: inset 0px 0px 0px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15), 0px 2px 3px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); text-align: center; } .ds-prayer-card h3 { color: #3e3e3e; font-size: 2em; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.5em; } .ds-prayer-card h1 { color: #43B3E0; font-size: 3.25em; font-weight: 300; }

components.name: Navigation
components.css: .ds-nav { background: #282828; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; z-index: 10000; } .ds-nav a { color: #fff; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.2em 1em; margin: 0.6em 0.2em; display: block; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: #383838; }

narrative.overview: A utility-first prayer time display. The interface is invisible — users come for the times, not the design. Clean, fast, no fluff. Modernized with flat design buttons and proper contrast.
keyCharacteristics: Minimal visual noise — every element serves the prayer time display
Fast page load, no JavaScript bloat

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Buttons use flat design with hover state changes (transform: translateY)

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Body text uses #666 for WCAG AA compliance

dos: Keep the interface minimal — utility first
Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text)
Use the sky blue accent sparingly
donts: Add features that distract from prayer times
Use generic Bootstrap-style gradients or effects
Increase visual complexity — users want quick time lookups
Use gray body text (#888) that fails contrast
